hero.eyebrow: A personal study for your whole life
hero.title: Keep your days like a scholar keeps a notebook.
hero.body: Tasks, calendar, goals, habits, focus sessions, a journal and reports, gathered in one quiet, private place. It works offline and installs on your phone like an app.
hero.note: Personal and self-hosted: one account, your own server.

features.title: Everything a well-kept life needs
features.body: Eight rooms in one house, all talking to each other.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: Quick capture with #tags and dates in plain words, subtasks, priorities, and smart views: Today, Upcoming, Overdue.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Day, week and month views with repeating events, working hours and time blocked for your tasks.

goals.title: Goals
goals.body: Long aims broken into milestones, with progress that fills in as linked tasks and habits get done.

habits.title: Habits
habits.body: Daily or weekly habits, one-tap check-ins, streaks and a year of history at a glance.

focus.title: Focus
focus.body: A pomodoro timer tied to the task at hand, with a gentle bell and a log of your deep work.

journal.title: Journal
journal.body: A page a day for mood, energy and thoughts, with prompts for when the page is blank.

reports.title: Insights & reports
reports.body: Charts of how your time goes, plus daily, weekly and monthly reports to read, download or receive by email.

graph.title: The graph
graph.body: Everything unfinished as a living map: goals as wax seals, deadlines as astrolabes, tasks circling what's due.

morning.title: Plan the day
morning.body: See what's due, drag tasks into the calendar and choose the three things that matter.

noon.title: Focus
noon.body: Start a focus session on the task in front of you; reminders keep the rest out of mind.

evening.title: Check in
evening.body: Tick off habits, write a few lines in the journal, and let tomorrow's plan carry over.

week.title: Review
week.body: A weekly review and a report of the week: what moved, what stalled, what's next.

themes.title: A study to suit your mood
themes.body: Pick the light iOS look, a dark one, or Academia: a library by candlelight, a chalkboard, an observatory, parchment or a botanist's plates.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Keeps working without a connection and syncs when you're back.

install.title: Installs like an app
install.body: Add it to your phone's Home Screen for notifications and a full-screen app.

own.title: Your own server
own.body: Your data lives in your database. Nothing is sold, tracked or shared.

export.title: Take it with you
export.body: Download a full backup any time, and readable PDF reports.

footer.title: Your notebook is waiting.
footer.made: Life OS · a personal study for your whole life
